title: cyclophorus gralla
intro: Cyclophorus gralla, commonly known as the "Monkey Cup," is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. Cyclophorus gralla has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
